blocks.text: You can use the grouping feature in applications in the Agentic Security Operations Platform (Agentic SecOps Platform) to organize the data on entity pages:

blocks.item: Unified Vulnerability Management (UVM): Tickets, Assets, Findings, and Exceptions
Asset Exposure Management (AEM): Assets, Violation Tickets, Policy Violations, and Users
Agentic SOC: Incidents, Alerts, Assets, and Users
Identity Protection: Users, Identity Findings, Tenants, and Alerts

blocks.text: Grouping your view creates collapsible sections based on the field you select. For example, grouping the UVM Tickets view by Ticket Severity categorizes the tickets into the different severity values (e.g., Info, Low, Medium, High, Critical).
To add grouping to a page:

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, go to the entity page (e.g., Tickets in UVM).
Click the Group By drop-down menu.
Select the field you want to group the view by (e.g., Ticket Severity).

blocks.text: The view is updated by your selected grouping. To remove the grouping, click Clear Selection at the bottom of the Group By drop-down menu.
Your grouping preferences can be saved as a set view. To learn more, see Creating & Managing Saved Views.
